name: qBittorrent
description: A torrent client with a clean web interface.
notes: The first password is printed in its log (Containers → qbittorrent → Logs).
compose:
services:
  qbittorrent:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/qbittorrent:latest
    container_name: qbittorrent
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:8085"
      - "6881:6881"
      - "6881:6881/udp"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: "{TZ}"
      WEBUI_PORT: "8085"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/config:/config
      - /srv/downloads:/downloads
